import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { invoice } from "../../../backend/schema/invoice";

export const invoiceCms = customizeTable<typeof invoice>("invoice", {
    icon: "ShoppingCart",
    listFields: [
        "invoiceId",
        "invoiceDate",
        "billingAddress",
        "billingCity",
        "billingState",
        "billingCountry"
    ],
    fieldOrder: [
        "invoiceId",
        "invoiceDate",
        "billingAddress",
        "billingCity",
        "billingState",
        "billingCountry",
        "billingPostalCode",
        "total",
        "customer"
    ]
});
